title: 自进化智能体：法律案例检索的规则驱动查询重写框架
summary: 提出一种无需参数训练的自进化框架，利用LLM智能体自动生成和优化查询重写规则，提升BM25在法律案例检索中的性能。在LeCaRD-v2基准上超越非进化基线，揭示了LLM利用历史实验和内在知识进行规则消除的关键作用。
summary_en: Proposes a self-evolving framework for rule-driven query rewriting that enhances BM25 without parameter training, using an LLM-based agent to iteratively create and refine rules. Outperforms non-evolutionary baselines on LeCaRD-v2, highlighting the role of leveraging experimental history and intrinsic knowledge for rule elimination.
